'''Toleen Bisma''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Bisma kept the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Sha'lia]] as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], although she eventually escaped from him, with the help of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Goort]]. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Bisma featured in a vision that Sha'lia experienced in the [[Temple of Pain]], in the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]].
